pricing_hazards.name: Dark Ponman
pricing_hazards.claim: amount=3 and count=3 on an Add-3 module; a generic amount-times-count reader would create 9 cards. Two Switch branches must stay exclusive.
pricing_hazards.minimal_review_check: Add branch yields 3 Ponman before capacity handling, not 9; buff branch does not also add cards.

pricing_hazards.name: Soul Cage
pricing_hazards.claim: V5 target=hand has no structured recipient; current-turn player is not necessarily owner. The 1-COST modification must bind to the generated Knife.
pricing_hazards.minimal_review_check: Death on owner turn adds Knife to owner; death on opponent turn adds it to opponent. Do not always credit owner with a bonus card.

pricing_hazards.name: Echo Fish
pricing_hazards.claim: V5 kind=transform,target=enemy_monster identifies the copy source but does not explicitly bind the changed recipient to this card.
pricing_hazards.minimal_review_check: Copying enemy 8/8 changes Echo Fish into an 8/8 with the listed statuses; the enemy 8/8 remains. Do not credit removal of the copied enemy.
